meta.title: Approval notifications
meta.description: Raises a macOS Notification Center banner at the four moments an agent waits for you: a tool approval, an ask_user_question prompt, a finished turn, and a session error, each with its own switch. A bundled DSH Notify helper app posts the banner from its own identity, so clicking it brings DSH back to the front. The notification permission is requested only through the settings page's request button — a notification never opens an authorization dialog; without it (or after a denial) delivery falls back to the osascript channel, which needs no permission but shows as Script Editor and cannot be clicked. The alert tone rides along with the banner and is played by the system (approval Glass, question Ping, finish Tink, error Basso); finish reminders are skipped while DSH is frontmost, and error reminders are limited to one per five minutes, and sessions created by scheduled runs stay quiet by default. Switches, a test notice, a self-check and the four counters live in Settings → Plugins → Approval notifications. Approval reminders only appear while the permission preset asks for approval (read-only or workspace-write); the full-access preset rejects those calls outright. The plugin never answers an approval or a question.
